children.label: Grade minimum
children.note: You need a C or higher in all required courses. This isn't checked automatically.
children.devNote: Bulletin: 'A grade of C or higher is required in all of the aforementioned courses to receive units in the major. All required courses are 4 unit hours.' Honors in the Major (MR 401/402, GPA 3.25/3.5), the Undergraduate Research Options (MR 291/292, 391/392, 491/492) and the 'maximum of 12 research units may be counted as elective courses' cap are not modeled: the major has no elective slot for them to fill.

children.label: Core Introductory Courses (2)
children.devNote: CAS MR 144 ('Intro to Oceanography Disc') is EE 144's discussion, not a twin; CAS ES 144 is the inactive old subject code. Neither is listed.

children.label: Biology
children.devNote: Bulletin lists only BI 107 and BI 108 (no CGS NS 201 / BI 116 equivalents, unlike the Biology BA).

children.label: Chemistry
children.devNote: Bulletin order. No CH 101 + CH 116 option here (the Biology BA has one). MET CH 101/102/171/172 exist in the catalog but are MET courses, not cross-listings; not included.

children.label: Physics
children.devNote: Bulletin: 'CAS PY 105 or 211'. One course, not a two-term sequence.

children.label: Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science

pool.label: One calculus, statistics, or computer science course

children.devNote: Three named slots (pool.length === min, like the Economics core). Pool order is claim order: the statistics slot claims before the 'one more' slot, so MA 115/213 (in both) go to statistics first and only a second stats course falls through to 'one more'. Greedy is optimal here because the calculus slot shares no keys with the others. CAS MA 213E (study abroad) is left out.

children.label: Marine Breadth Courses (3 total)
children.note: It's recommended that you cover a variety of areas (BO, MB, PO, CO, MG, MSD).
children.devNote: 19 courses in bulletin order. Area codes (BO, MB, PO, CO, MG, MSD) are a recommendation only and not modeled. Cross-listed twins found in public/courses.json (not named in the bulletin): AR 518 = AN 518 (Zooarchaeology), EE 423 = BI 423 (Marine Biogeochemistry); each is one OR_EQUIVALENT slot so both keys can't count. Plain runs are COURSE_LISTs (no twins inside, so they count the same as plain keys) with continues: true so the whole list draws as one box; the BI and EE runs are split so neither passes the 12-row list limit (which adds a filter box and hides rows behind Show more). Graduate twins (BI 610, BI 613, BI/EE 623) and inactive ES/GE old-code keys left out.

children.label: Marine Semester Courses (4 total)
children.note: The BU Marine Program places you in four month-long courses, so you don't choose them. Add the Marine Semester to a Fall term in your plan, or use ⋯ → Substitute a course for each course you've taken.
children.devNote: No course list: the BU Marine Program places students into four month-long courses, one per block, and offerings change every year (the bulletin's 'currently include' list is not maintained here). filledByBlock: 'marine' — a Marine Semester block in the plan (src/data/specialTerms.js) fills all four slots. A student who took the courses another way (e.g. from a transcript) uses ⋯ → Substitute a course four times. 'In lieu of one of the four Marine Semester block courses, students may enroll in 4 units of Research for Units' (prearranged, approved by the Marine Program Director) is also a substitution.
